summary: Full E2E regression PASSED. Backend 24/24 tests (100%) including new TestParlay class (4 legs param: 2/3/4/5) and explicit regression test for GET /api/picks/{pick_id} verifying the restored decorator returns 200 with ai_pending bool + full pick fields. Frontend 12/12 mobile flows passed: login → Locks (50 cards, tap opens detail with Lock score + Why This Pick section) → Rollover (best pick visible) → Parlay (default 3-leg renders, 2/4/5 switching re-fetches, gold notice banner appears when only 4 of 5 Lock 90+ qualify, tapping a leg navigates to /pick/{id} — end-to-end regression confirmed) → Bet Killer (92 dangerous bets) → Profile (demo user + logout returns to login). AI explanation content now appears to be real Claude output (not fallback template) — markdown headings like '## Why This Pick Has Value' and structured reasoning observed, suggesting the LLM budget issue from iteration_1 is resolved. One non-blocking warning persists: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' from a third-party RN lib.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Same as iteration_1 — emitted on app boot, likely from Reanimated/Gesture-Handler. Non-blocking. Reference: browser console during /login → / navigation.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Track the source of 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' warning — likely a transitive dep (Reanimated 3.x or react-native-gesture-handler). No immediate fix needed.

OPTIONAL: Verify on a fresh pick (force refresh) that AI explanation source='live' via POST /api/picks/{id}/ai-explain to confirm Claude budget is fully healthy (iteration_1 reported budget exhaustion; iteration_2 sees what looks like real AI markdown, so it appears resolved).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/picks/{pick_id} still caches the first explanation (fallback or real) into Mongo via the POST /ai-explain. If a fallback was cached before the budget was raised, it will keep returning the stale fallback. Consider only persisting when source='live' (already does — only caches when `real` is True — good). Verified ai_engine returns real=True only on success.
sports_engine.py still uses random.uniform in pick generation (flagged in iteration_1) — picks change shape across /api/picks/refresh calls. Not user-facing yet but undermines reproducibility.
server.py is ~380 lines — still under the 700-line threshold but growing; consider extracting picks routes to a separate router module if more endpoints are added.
